findings.observation: Nexus prints the complete one-shot material block before saving material_delivery and exporting the public handoff. V4 starts Connector immediately at that block, while Connector reads the handoff before stdin.
findings.consequence: Connector can read a still-absent handoff and fail the single reserved transfer. The existing conservative refusal prevents replay but does not eliminate this ordering race.
findings.minimal_resolution: Require handoff initially absent in wrapper; keep producer drained and defer consumer until the exact canonical public handoff marker emitted after atomic_json. Keep canonical Connector content/scope validation and deadline; no retry.
findings.resolution_at_snapshot: not implemented; parent approved a separate V5 preparation after this review
